name: caption-checker
role: Checks SRT and WebVTT captions against named captioning limits
notes: 2026-11-08: Triage: A machine-checking route for caption rules is distinct from conversion and rendering; revisit after independent validation and rule coverage review.
documentation_status uses legacy listed-in-prd value for a listed-only discovery candidate; this is not evidence of PRD inclusion.

2026-11-24: Guide skills/caption-checker/SKILL.md written from examples/caption-checker-limits (netflix profile only; BBC/DCMP, gap and reading-speed rules, fix/convert and MCP untested). Not on npm; install as a commit-pinned git dependency.

evidence.result: netflix profile on two clean captions files (SRT, WebVTT, 5 cues each): exit 0, zero issues. Two files with predeclared violations (6 cues each): exit 1, exactly 4 flagged cues: cue 2 cpl (line of 61 characters), cue 3 lines (3 lines), cue 4 short (0.40 s), cue 5 overlap (0.50 s). SRT and WebVTT agree; each file's two JSON runs byte-identical. Node v22.19.0, macOS arm64.
evidence.scope: netflix profile, hand-written SRT and WebVTT: clean files 0 issues; 4 predeclared violations on the right cues; reruns identical; no other profiles or rule kinds; macOS arm64.

summary: Zero-dependency CLI and library checks SRT/WebVTT captions against Netflix, BBC and DCMP limits for reading speed, line length, line count, duration, gaps and overlaps. It reports compliance issues rather than rendering or translating captions.

install.macos: project-local in examples/caption-checker-limits: dependency github:markksantos/caption-checker#4a504ede1606fbefd7e7b658281b9b8f7a4ef9e2 (v1.3.3, MIT), then pnpm install; the npm registry has no caption-checker package

use_when: Check subtitle reading speed, line length and gaps against its named SRT/WebVTT rule sets
Use a report-only caption compliance pass after timing and authoring
avoid_when: Use ttconv for subtitle format conversion rather than compliance checks
Use FFmpeg when you need to render subtitles into video frames

assessment.rationale: Repository documents a zero-dependency CLI/library and named rule sets for SRT/WebVTT; recent repository activity is visible. Package release/version and exact install command need confirmation before promotion.
